notes: Table 0 is the product population (identity + name); table 1 supplies price and currency keyed by the same material codes, so delivery records must be joined on material code rather than emitted per sheet.

Material code is reported by the profiler as int with values like '000001'; the source stores/display these zero-padded, so the mapping must emit sku as text to satisfy the contract's leading-zero requirement.

Table 1 has 13 rows but only 12 distinct material codes: code '000004' occurs twice. Prices for '000004' conflict and the operator states no precedence rule exists, so this needs a business decision rather than a silent pick.
Selling price '9999' is a strong outlier against a 113–256 range; it may be a placeholder/sentinel price but the source gives no flag column to verify this, so it has not been treated as null.
Both sheets have zero formulas, zero error cells and no hidden rows/columns, so all values are directly readable.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Material' is a two-column master list: one unique identity code per row (12 distinct in 12 rows) and one human-readable product description (12 distinct). No price, quantity or status attributes, so it is the product master, not pricing or inventory.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Unique per row (unique_ratio 1.0) with sku_like hint; displayed values such as '000001' are zero-padded, so it must be read as text and not cast to int, per the contract's 'preserve leading zeros'.

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Free-text label describing each material ('Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11'); matches the contract's 'Product name from the master list'.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Prices' pairs a material reference code with a single numeric amount column and a currency column constant at THB — a per-material price list. It links to the products table by material code rather than defining products itself.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Values 1–12 overlap the Material master's codes (zero-padded text such as '000001'); acts as a foreign key to the product population and the natural join key for the price.

columns.name: Selling price
columns.reason: Only monetary-looking numeric column, never null, range 113–256 with one outlier at 9999; matches the contract's 'requested selling price'. Confidence reduced because material code 000004 appears on two rows with different amounts and no source precedence rule exists.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Constant single value 'THB' across all 13 rows — an explicit ISO 4217 code stated by the source, not inferred from locale.
